notes.title: Edicts of Forge and Flame - Dispatches of Swift Repair, Hotfix Highlights
notes.notes:
Greetings, brave souls of Crestfallen,

What an exhilarating first day it has been! We extend our deepest gratitude to each and every one of you who embarked on this journey with us. Your enthusiasm and feedback have been invaluable as we navigate the uncharted realms of our new world.

In the wake of our launch, we've been hard at work addressing your initial experiences and concerns. Here are some of the key fixes and adjustments we've implemented:

Increased Server Capacity

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/6fe3e300ff761e2642bcf49630dbe7c3270fe16d.jpg

Our servers can now comfortably accommodate up to 50 players at a time, ensuring smoother gameplay and reduced wait times.

Improved Player Re-connection 

Players should no longer encounter issues with getting stuck on loading screens when reconnecting to the game.

Bulwark of Castle Wall

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/3c312d0fbb14539bc501bc1cb110e8027ad37112.png

Slow down siege and raider attacks drastically. Castle Wall, Castle Gate, and Castle Turret Hit Points have been buffed from 35,000 hp to 350,000 hp. They now are more secure than stone wall for raid defense.

Weapon Balancing

The damage of the Steel T3 Halberd has been adjusted from 205 to 150, with durability reduced from 500 to 50. These changes aim to balance gameplay and reduce raiding efficiency.

Camera Stability

We've disabled camera shake for players who are not actively casting Meteor spells, enhancing overall visual comfort during gameplay.

Spell Adjustments 

Meteor and fire spells have been overhauled to ensure they no longer inadvertently damage internal structures and are more finely tuned for balance.

Teleportation Mechanics

Teleportation is now too expensive to cast, but for those cunning enough to uncover a secret path, the possibility remains open.

Economic Balance 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/83276cb711d2d02eaed06ce8438d968cec0c6f66.png

Spear racks in town and certain higher-tier loot have been strategically removed to offer new adventurers a more balanced starting experience.

Better Burn Rate

Wall torches and  candelabras are now burning fuel at a much slower rate so you wont have to refill often at all!

Your feedback continues to guide us as we strive to refine and perfect Crestfallen. Together, we are forging a world where every decision and adjustment aims to enhance your gameplay experience.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue this epic journey together. Remember, your adventures shape the future of Crestfallen!

May your swords stay sharp and your spirits high.


My sword is at thy service,

King Burkheart The Keeper of Justice
"JUSTICE WILL BE SERVED!!"

notes.title: It's Game Time! Thy Release Date is NIGH, WE MARCH TO BATTLE!!
notes.notes:
Good Morrow People of Thy Realm!

I am thrilled to announce the release of Crestfallen: Medieval Survival, an immersive and challenging exploration into the heart of a magical, bloody, and mysterious world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/5d9d423a4344ceb1a9210e80c0deaac14139f804.png

Let me start this Game Release announcement with the most sacred of thanks to my community, for without them this game would not exist. A love filled thank you to my wife and kids who have given me the time and driven the passion of my creations. My two most deadly brothers in arms; Patrick and James my Life, my Sword......, my Crown, is yours.

LET THE GAMES BEGIN!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/e6287796959764a1d529a1fcde998e39c74c9722.png

As a lone adventurer, you must navigate...

Dynamic Survival Mechanics: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/05028776ed4e7891b4afef3b19446bc086e48607.jpg

Experience a deep and realistic survival system where every decision matters. Manage resources such as food, water, and shelter while crafting essential tools and weapons to fend off threats.

Unforgiving World: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/d560f910d0f85f4d07107e6a8e677ca3395ccf4b.png

Explore a vast, open-world environment teeming with hostile creatures and rival factions. Adapt to changing weather conditions and day-night cycles that influence gameplay dynamics. Everything wants you dead!

Strategic Combat: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/0b818e06d8ae961a7df0c8d904b9b95033bb8cbb.jpg

Engage in visceral, skill-based combat that demands precision and tactical thinking. Master a variety of weapons and combat styles to overcome enemies ranging from feral beasts, skilled knights, and fire breathing dragons!

Skills and Progression: 

Magic or Might? Level up and improve your skills through a robust stat and skill system. Customize your character's abilities and equipment to suit your preferred play-style.

Atmospheric Soundtrack and Visuals: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/caaa3d61ff2855c9e3376c5a4e58e0416ccb7cf4.jpg

Immerse yourself in a hauntingly beautiful world brought to life with stunning visuals and an evocative musical score that enhances the game's atmosphere and emotional depth.

Why Crestfallen?

Crestfallen isn't just another survival game; it's a testament to the human spirit in the face of adversity. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/6a08be8c5315a0c29b304e42bd72f3e9eee1ee3b.jpg

It challenges you to survive not only physically but morally and ethically, as your choices ripple through the narrative, affecting the world and its inhabitants. Whether you seek the thrill of exploration, the challenge of survival, or the satisfaction of overcoming insurmountable odds, Crestfallen promises an unforgettable experience.

Join Us on this Epic Journey:

Prepare to embark on a journey that will test your courage, wit, and resilience like never before. Crestfallen beckons you to explore its depths, confront its challenges, and carve your own legend in a world where survival is the ultimate victory.

Release Details:

Crestfallen: Medieval Survival will be available on PC starting at 10 a.m. PST on July 17th, 2024. Hosting official servers around the world so everyone can get a great experience and have fun together!


Are You Ready to Survive?

The kingdom awaits, adventurer. The fate of Tyraellia lies in your hands.

I live to Serve,
King Burkheart The Keeper Of Justice
"JUSTICE WILL BE SERVED!!"

Looking forward, please review out timeline and goals for the future!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/89ea9ee3a8f2ccfe5dd91f5659c17a35d0e416e4.jpg

and the map of Tyraellia for our 1.0 release:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/4b6bbb52fb67ef03a5d86ad4fe8e0368e3695bba.jpg

notes.title: Patch News: Kingdom Update
notes.notes:
Description:
Inventory Avatar Feature: Behold the latest addition to thy arsenal - the inventory avatar feature! Now, adventurers can easily access their inventory directly from the main HUD menu, providing quick access to thy wares and treasures.

Dragon Flyover and Loot Drop: A dragon soars majestically over the kingdom, dropping a dragon egg filled to the brim with coveted loot. Brave souls can dare to claim the treasures within, but beware the fiery breath of the dragon!

Quick Craft Option: Craftsmen and craftswomen rejoice! A new quick craft option hath been added to the main HUD, allowing thee to swiftly craft items for which thou hast already gathered the materials. Streamline thy crafting process and forge ahead on thy quest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/3fbba042b5e6c498844ffb6b75467fb77379e2ff.jpg

Tavern Roleplay: The local tavern hath become a lively hub for adventurers to gather and regale tales of valor. Not only canst thou loot the tavern for treasures, but now thou canst also sit down within its hallowed halls and engage in merry roleplay with thy companions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/2afe5e50ac9381ec1274008627530b3fc190f09f.jpg

New Furnishings: Enhance the grandeur of thy castle with a plethora of new chairs, thrones, and tables added to the workbench. Deck thy halls with fine furnishings fit for a noble ruler, and make thy mark upon the kingdom.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/94cc758731b3ded66e742e6f715267effc880bb4.jpg

Patch Notes:

 Added inventory avatar feature to main HUD menu.
 Introduced dragon flyover event with loot drop.
 Implemented quick craft option for expedited crafting.
 Enabled roleplay interactions within the tavern environment.
 Expanded workbench offerings with new chairs, thrones, and tables.


Prepare thyself, brave adventurers, for the kingdom beckons with untold riches and adventures aplenty! Embark on thy quest and carve thy legend into the annals of history.

notes.title: Free Demo on Steam NOW!! Exciting New Features in Patch 0.01
notes.notes:
On this day, in the year of our kingdom, 2024, the heralds announce a Dev Blog that beckons thee to explore the realms of Crestfallen - a Medieval Survival of grand proportions. As the sun wanes and the moon ascends, cast thine eyes upon the digital emporium of Steam at this sacred link: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2293680/Crestfallen_Medieval_Survival/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/ca60745d85c6a361da48c4e03b97869e883110c0.png

Hark, noble companions and valiant supporters, lend thine ears to the joyous proclamation that resonates through the halls of development! With boundless mirth do I declare the revelry that surrounds the growth of our esteemed team, as it burgeons forth with the speed of a coursing steed. Lo and behold, a multitude of enthusiasts, devoted to the cause of medieval and survival games, hath gathered in our digital court to lend their hands in the forging of a masterpiece.

Inexpressible is the gratitude that doth swell within my heart for those stalwart souls who have heaved the siege wagon forward with unyielding might. A thunderous accolade resounds for my seasoned veterans, James, Patrick, Luke, and Lak1z! These titans of the realm, whose shoulders bear the weight of progress, deserve the highest commendation.

A resplendent welcome, akin to the warm glow of a hearth, I extend to the newly arrived helpers and allies. Rayner and his elite, Pash, Dr. Smoke and his entourage – thy names shall be etched into the chronicles of our shared endeavor. Assemble, O Discord ranks, forming the middle column for the impending battle!

Behold, my Knights of The Round Table, a formidable force whose valor doth swell my heart with pride beyond measure. Together, we march forth, an indomitable phalanx, forging a legacy that shall endure through the annals of time. May the winds of fortune guide us as we navigate this grand odyssey!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/20a23ae90a31b1bdcc1d5ce36fcdf212413626df.png

Verily, let it be known to all who dwell in this digital realm, that a moment of gratitude and admiration doth unfold! I, the humble architect of this grand tapestry, find it imperative to extend my heartfelt appreciation unto ALLLLL the assets that have graced this undertaking with their brilliance. Their collective prowess hath adorned my countenance with a joyous smile, akin to the glow of the sun upon a summer morn.

In the sanctum of game development, a journey that rivals the grandest epics, I confess with jubilant exuberance that this endeavor hath proven to be amongst the finest blessings bestowed upon my mortal coil. A confession, whispered amidst the digital shadows, that this pursuit has become a source of unparalleled joy, eclipsing even the joys of hearth and kin. Let it be known to all, and keepeth it hushed from mine own wife and offspring, for they know not the secrets of my digital dalliance.

And lo, as the number four burgeons in the womb of time, a new addition to my familial realm, I find myself immersed in the creation of a digital legacy. A game crafted not merely for coin or prestige, but for the very soul of the gamers – those stalwart companions who have tread the gaming paths for nigh unto four decades.

With every keystroke and pixel placed, I delve into the depths of detail and polish, forsooth, a touch of the obsessive, as I channel the accumulated wisdom of my near forty years of play. A game wrought from the crucible of passion, crafted to sate the cravings of my fellow gamers and kindred spirits. May this digital creation stand as a testament to the undying flame that burns within the heart of every true aficionado of the gaming realm!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/83276cb711d2d02eaed06ce8438d968cec0c6f66.png

Hear me, noble denizens of the digital domain! I, the humble architect of this virtual fiefdom, must render homage to the masterminds at Polyphoria, whose craftsmanship hath bestowed upon our creation a splendor that rivals the treasures of the celestial heavens. Armors that gleam with the brilliance of a thousand suns, garments that cloak our characters in an aura of majesty, elves, barbs, cultists, dwarves, and secrets concealed in the shadows — all are gifts from the adept hands of Polyphoria.

Verily, as I gaze upon these digital marvels, a profound sense of awe courses through my being. The textures, a mere 512 in magnitude, weave a tapestry of performance and visual allure that enraptures the senses. Though I, in my quest for perfection, may have subjected myself to the rigors of tireless toil in their implementation, the fruits of this labor stand as a testament to the seamless harmony betwixt form and function.

Behold, ye denizens of the gaming realm, the wondrous spectacle that Polyphoria hath crafted! I urge thee to embark upon a pilgrimage to their digital forge, not by the beckoning of sponsorship, but by the sheer love and reverence that I bear for their artistry. Witness the splendors they have wrought at this sacred link: https://polyphoria.com/

As for the foundations that underpin our digital citadels, the buildings and castles that rise as beacons of grandeur, I have assembled a treasury of assets. A 500-gig project, a trove of the most splendid and awe-inspiring creations that the Unreal Engine marketplace hath to offer. With the benevolent gaze of Unreal 5.3.2 and the latest technological marvels, we shape this bad boy into a masterpiece that shall stand the test of time. Let the pixels dance and the code sing, for our creation shall be a symphony of wonder in the grand tapestry of gaming history!

Hark! Rejoice, for our digital realm flourishes with life and vitality! Behold, our multiplayer functions, like the dance of the stars, perform with seamless grace upon our gleaming new Official Dedicated Servers. Praise be unto James, a stalwart ally, and Styx Networks, whose prowess in hosting hath birthed an unparalleled sanctuary for our creation.

With unyielding might, James hath orchestrated a symphony of networks, automating a grand 50k undertaking. The servers, entwined in a tapestry of brilliance, stand as the epitome of speed and intelligence. Thanks to this feat, I, like a madman, continue to forge new realms and unleash updates upon the land almost daily.

Alas, the conundrum of growth! A profusion of content demands moments of reprieve as we expand the horizons of our kingdom. To those who wield grand castles, apologies for the intermittent downtimes – the crucible of progress knows no respite. Yet, fear not, for as stability graces our realm, discussions of a weekly or bi-weekly routine shall emerge to soothe the vexed hearts.

In the twilight of patience, our servers stand firm, and the promise of a thriving digital kingdom beckons. Let the updates flow like a river, and may our dedicated servers be the bedrock upon which our digital legacy is etched into the annals of gaming history!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/0c20e7911a6cc49c79b52a8712c645d3c68f7e8b.png

Hark! The decree resounds across the digital realms, as I, the architect of this grand tapestry, set forth a proclamation. On the first day of July, in the year 2024, the gates of our creation shall swing wide, ushering in an era of digital majesty. In the span of these approaching months, a flurry of endeavors shall unfold, each a crucial stitch in the fabric of our grand endeavor.

A quest system, robust and intricate, shall unfurl like the pages of an ancient manuscript, weaving together the narratives of all factions into a harmonious MMORPG tapestry. The instruments of war, the catapult, ballista, and trebuchet, shall undergo a meticulous polish, their mechanisms honed to flawless precision, ready to unleash havoc upon the raiding realms.

Behold the user interface, a portal into the heart of our digital kingdom, where every pixel resonates with the theme that defines our creation. In the crucible of development, bugs and optimizations shall be attended to with the precision of a master smith, ensuring a seamless experience for those who venture into our realms.

Upon the fertile grounds of our creation, horses shall gallop, noble steeds to carry our players across the vast expanse. And in the heavens above, whispers of a dragon's flight echo. Yet, tread carefully, for the wings of the majestic creature shall only bear players aloft if balance prevails, and the specter of overpowering shall not cast its shadow upon our digital landscape.

As the clock ticks towards the appointed day, let our unity be our strength. On July 1st, 2024, we shall stand at the precipice, ready to unfurl the banner of our creation, and together, we shall embark on a journey into the annals of gaming history.

notes.title: Siege Update Unleashed: Crestfallen's Battlefield Erupts in Chaos!
notes.notes:
Warriors of Crestfallen, the time has come for a revolution in medieval warfare! Our Siege Update introduces a dynamic and immersive gameplay experience, reshaping the very foundations of Crestfallen's battlegrounds. Prepare to immerse yourself in a realm of relentless conquest, where every strategic move can change the course of history.

AI and Player-Built Castles:
Embark on daring sieges against formidable AI fortresses or challenge fellow players by assaulting their meticulously crafted castles. Battle-tested warriors will clash within the walls, determining the true lords of the realm.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/a8885c5eece7e196f69b4951fd291432da4eb9af.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/a3872edfc27305b076965a603bf133271a677b17.png

PVP Intensity:
The Siege Update amplifies the thrill of player-versus-player combat. Prove your mettle in intense battles, showcasing your individual skills and strategic prowess. Will you be the valiant defender or the conquering aggressor?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/8722172f0a0ab36a2adeca977f0e8ecadd7ac9f2.png

Legacy Building:
Forge your legacy in the annals of Crestfallen's history. As the dust settles from each siege, kingdoms will rise and fall. Your actions will be etched into the lore, shaping the narrative of a dynamic and ever-evolving medieval world.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/8f42f5e19d14d6beef3f89242a86014aff20dd0f.png

In regards to the Free Trial, we extend our deepest apologies for the rescheduling to February. We recognize your excitement, and this delay is a testament to our commitment to delivering an unparalleled gaming experience. Stay tuned for the announcement of the exact date, as we work diligently to ensure that the Free Trial offers an immersive taste of the grandeur that Crestfallen: Medieval Survival has to offer. Prepare for the Siege Update, and may your conquests echo through the ages!
